{"action":"shell","command": "cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# TTL=2 with timer starting at 0 means expiry=2
# At exact boundary (time=2), key IS expired per R08
now = [0]
c = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: now[0])
c.put('a', 1, ttl=2)
now[0] = 1
assert c.get('a') == 1  # not expired yet
# At exact boundary time=2, key is expired
try:
    c.get('a')
    print('FAIL at boundary')
except KeyError:
    print('PASS: expired at exact boundary')

# TTL zero is immediately expired
c = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: 0)
c.put('a', 1, ttl=0)
assert len(c) == 0
print('PASS: TTL=0 immediately expired')

# Invalid TTL
c = TaggedCache(2)
try:
    c.put('a', 1, ttl=-1)
    print('FAIL')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: negative TTL rejected')

try:
    c.put('a', 1, ttl=True)
    print('FAIL')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: bool TTL rejected')

try:
    c.put('a', 1, ttl=float('inf'))
    print('FAIL')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: inf TTL rejected')

# Test no TTL (None) - never expires
c = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: 1000)
c.put('a', 1)
assert c.get('a') == 1
print('PASS: no TTL never expires')

# Test overwrite replaces expiry
c = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: now[0])
c.put('a', 1, ttl=2)
now[0] = 1
c.put('a', 2, ttl=10)  # overwrite with longer TTL
now[0] = 5
assert c.get('a') == 2  # still alive
print('PASS: overwrite replaces expiry')

# Expired entries removed before put/len/resize/invalidation
c = TaggedCache(3, timer=lambda: now[0])
c.put('a', 1, ttl=1)
c.put('b', 2, ttl=1)
c.put('c', 3, ttl=1)
now[0] = 2
assert len(c) == 0  # all expired
print('PASS: expired removed before len')

# Tag invalidation counts only live entries
c = TaggedCache(3, timer=lambda: now[0])
c.put('a', 1, ['x'], ttl=1)
c.put('b', 2, ['x'], ttl=100)
now[0] = 2
assert c.invalidate('x') == 1  # only 'b' is live
assert c.get('b') == 2
print('PASS: invalidation counts only live')

print('\n=== ALL TESTS PASSED ===')
